gate: 0.4 - can webhooks be received at all?
verdict: PASS - a Razorpay-originated event was received, signature-verified, and logged

proof.signed_by: Razorpay (HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, verified against the Dashboard secret)
proof.note: Distinguished from our own self-tests by event-id shape: Razorpay ids are bare tokens like TX3rOCAcRmbwOd, ours are prefixed evt_*.

delivery_latency.note: The 8s is Razorpay's own dispatch delay plus tunnel transit. Our ACK, measured separately, is ~1.5-2.7s through zrok - inside the 5s budget because the handler verifies, enqueues and returns without processing inline.

architectural_finding_error_fields_arriv: The webhook payload carries the same five error fields as GET /payments/:id. The diagnosis layer can therefore classify straight off the event without a follow-up API call - though the state re-check before ACTING still needs one, because payment.failed can be followed by payment.captured for the same transaction.

incident_the_gate_uncovered.symptom: 18+ deliveries arrived and every one was rejected 'invalid signature', while the endpoint reported perfectly healthy and the event log stayed empty.
incident_the_gate_uncovered.root_cause: The secret entered in the Dashboard had surrounding whitespace.
incident_the_gate_uncovered.why_it_was_invisible_at_first: Rejections were tracked in memory only, so 'Razorpay never called' and 'Razorpay called and we rejected it' looked identical. Durable rejection logging was added and immediately exposed it.
incident_the_gate_uncovered.misleading_heuristic: Filtering rejections by 'non-local peer IP' found nothing, because zrok proxies to localhost - peer is ALWAYS 127.0.0.1 for tunnelled traffic. The User-Agent (Razorpay-Webhook/v1) is the correct discriminator.

finding_signature_is_computed_once_per_e.claim: Razorpay signs an event ONCE at creation; retries replay the identical payload and signature. It does NOT re-sign per delivery attempt.
finding_signature_is_computed_once_per_e.test: 14 whitespace/quoting variants of the corrected secret were tested against the captured signatures of pre-fix events; none matched.
finding_signature_is_computed_once_per_e.operational_consequence: Rotating a webhook secret PERMANENTLY STRANDS every event already created under the old secret - they will retry for 24h and never verify. This is not stated in Razorpay's documentation and is worth designing around.

observed_retry_ladder.note: Razorpay's at-least-once redelivery, observed live rather than quoted from docs.
observed_retry_ladder.why_it_matters: Dedup on x-razorpay-event-id is load-bearing, not decorative.
